buyer.label: Who buys and what they want

engines.label: Answer engines, comma separated
engines.default: chatgpt, perplexity, gemini, google ai overviews

steps.title: Write the prompt set
steps.prompt: Buyer: {{inputs.buyer}}. Write {{run.dir}}/prompts.md: 15 questions this buyer asks an AI assistant before choosing, in their words. If {{project.path}}/.troop/geo-track/prompts.md exists, use it unchanged so runs stay comparable. Estimate the cost of asking all of them on {{inputs.engines}} and set cost_usd.

steps.title: Approve the queries
steps.gate_summary: Ask the prompts in {{run.dir}}/prompts.md on {{inputs.engines}}, about {{steps.prompts.outputs.cost_usd}} USD. Approve to run the paid queries.

steps.title: Ask every engine
steps.prompt: Ask every prompt in {{run.dir}}/prompts.md on each of {{inputs.engines}}. Save each answer with its cited URLs to {{run.dir}}/answers/<engine>-<n>.md. Set spent_usd to what it cost.

steps.title: Score mentions and sources
steps.prompt: For each answer in {{run.dir}}/answers/, record whether {{inputs.brand}} and each of {{inputs.rivals}} is mentioned, its position, the sentiment, and the cited domains. Write {{run.dir}}/scores.json and a short summary table in {{run.dir}}/scores.md, one row per prompt and one column per engine.

steps.title: Compare with last run
steps.prompt: Compare {{run.dir}}/scores.json with {{project.path}}/.troop/geo-track/last-scores.json if it exists. Flag every move of more than 2 positions and every cited source that appeared or vanished. Write {{run.dir}}/trend.md, then copy {{run.dir}}/scores.json to {{project.path}}/.troop/geo-track/last-scores.json and {{run.dir}}/prompts.md to {{project.path}}/.troop/geo-track/prompts.md.

steps.title: List the gaps
steps.prompt: From {{run.dir}}/scores.json and {{run.dir}}/trend.md, write {{run.dir}}/gaps.md: pages on our site to create or fix, and outside sources the engines cite that we should earn a mention on, each with the prompts it would move.

steps.title: Write the weekly report
steps.prompt: Write {{run.dir}}/report.md: where {{inputs.brand}} shows up and where it does not, what moved since last run from {{run.dir}}/trend.md, and the top five actions from {{run.dir}}/gaps.md. Set document to the report path.
